description: NR49 (theory) -- the frame-pair transfer of an evolving interface

verdicts.reading: The two-snapshot transfer factorizes exactly into gain x all-pass, and the all-pass factor is kinematics: on the real scallop field the pattern-band phase celerity (48.2 mm/hr) matches the committed trackers (55.8 xcorr), and Bushuk's co-moving frame annihilates 93% of it, while the growth spectrum stays put (pattern -0.06 vs -0.45 /hr; roughness -4.7 vs -5.9 /hr) -- boosts move phase, never gain.  The developed scallop state is a marginal pattern riding on minutes-lifetime damped roughness: NR44's attractor, seen spectrally.  NR48's delay and this boost are the same all-pass clock in conjugate variables (omega <-> k).
